description: Changes across AI models: new releases, price changes, API changes and deprecations. Normalized from vendor release notes, Hugging Face, the OpenRouter catalog, GitHub and the LiteLLM price map, deduplicated per model, each marked official or pending review. Poll with `since` (unix seconds) and feed the returned `latest` back next time.

since.description: Unix seconds. Only changes detected after this, oldest first.

name: list_model_changes
